merge.smartRecoveryApplied: Local changes were restored. The saved copy remains; do not apply it again.
merge.inlineHint: Arrows accept, × ignores. Accept both to combine; ignore both to keep the base. Non-conflicting changes are merged automatically.
merge.manualHint: This block has manual edits; replacement actions are disabled.

rewrite.keepHint: keep local changes; stop if they would be overwritten
